scientific_integrity: The infinite-dimensional assertion is supported by an explicit analytic proof; finite checks independently test the transition model. This claim has not undergone independent validation or historical-priority certification.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats independently resampled atomless record filtering, not the fixed-sample/longest-decreasing-subsequence variant. Convergence is weak with no Berry--Esseen rate or variance convergence claimed. Related general depletion-chain martingale theorems might affect historical priority. Exact finite checks are not proof of the asymptotic statement.
title: Gaussian pass-count fluctuations in resampled record filtering
